fn-map-04.front: Yellow area with a gold edge?
fn-map-04.back: First Nations reserve. Treated like private land: ask the band office.

fn-map-06.back: Motor vehicle closure. Driving or using a vehicle to hunt may be illegal inside.

fn-map-07.front: Thin black lines with numbers like 3-27?
fn-map-07.back: Management Unit boundaries. Seasons and limits are set by MU.
